concepts.title: ACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Outlines the steps, preconditions, commands, and verification checks required to activate Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band on a node and sector carrier.

concepts.title: Deactivation Procedure
concepts.description: Describes the traffic impact, execution steps, and commands for deactivating the Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band feature.

concepts.title: Feature Dependencies
concepts.description: Outlines feature, hardware, and network dependencies as well as operational limitations for Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band.

concepts.title: Feature Operation
concepts.description: Explains the closed-loop power control operation for FR2 serving cells, including SINR tracking, TPC command generation, and blockage recovery.

concepts.title: FEATURE OVERVIEW
concepts.description: Overview of Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band for NR FR2 carriers, detailing open-loop limitations, closed-loop gNodeB control mechanisms, and performance gains.

concepts.title: Network Impact
concepts.description: Overview of the network impacts associated with Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band, including interference, throughput, UE battery, signaling, and KPIs.

concepts.title: PARAMETERS
concepts.description: Configuration parameters for Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band set per NR sector carrier.

concepts.title: PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT
concepts.description: Outlines performance management guidelines, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), formulas, and counters for Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band.
